=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:184-204 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `ci_main_delta_select` keeps only completed runs and lets the run that finished last win, so a green delta push that finishes after a red scheduled full run hides the failure, and the next push takes the delta-only path from a red base.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated this MAJOR. It breaks the script's own invariant ("a red base stays red until a full run passes") and issue Goal 6, and the exposure can last up to 6 hours. minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dismissed it in their notes as designed or bounded behaviour (D4 / Q201 A) and did not report it.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1808-1809 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The ci.yml base-gate jq (`sort_by([(.value.updated_at // .value.created_at // ""), (0 - .key)]) | last`) sorts push and scheduled runs together, so a later-finishing green delta push masks a red scheduled full run.
  WHY: All three reviewers rated this MAJOR. In that window the gate reads "success", so the PR is skipped as `pr_specific_failure` instead of being filed.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:572-579 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The triage gate sorts push and scheduled runs together and picks the newest completed run, so a green delta push finishing after a red scheduled run makes the branch look healthy.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated this MAJOR. A triaged issue can be resolved early while the base is actually red.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:167-177 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `review_final_ci_sweep_base_ci_red` (`sort_by([(.updated_at // .created_at // ""), (.created_at // "")]) | last`) picks a newer green delta push over a red scheduled full run that finished earlier.
  WHY: All three reviewers rated this MAJOR. The function returns "not red", so the base sync, or the merge, proceeds onto a red main.
- agents.d/10156-main-push-delta-ci.md:8-11 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" registry entry lists only `mode=select|run_tests` for `CI_MAIN_DELTA`. It omits the new `mode=output outcome=fail reason=output_write_failed` line.
  WHY: All three reviewers rated this NIT. Log parsers or heal rules built on the registered mode set will not match the line that explains an output-write failure; job behaviour is unaffected.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:68-69 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The script header "Log" block (`CI_MAIN_DELTA mode=select|run_tests outcome=ok|full_required|fail`) does not list the `mode=output` / `output_write_failed` line that `ci_main_delta_output` emits at scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:106.
  WHY: Rated NIT. The contractual prefix documentation drifts from the emitted log line.
- README.md:191 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The README text `Logs CI_MAIN_DELTA mode=select\|run_tests ...` does not list the new `mode=output` value.
  WHY: Rated NIT. This is a third contract surface with the same mode-set drift.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:151 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The entry says `select` "takes the head of the newest successful push or scheduled run as the base", which implies a fallback to an older green base. In fact a red newest-finished run emits `base_red`/`full_required=true`.
  WHY: Rated NIT. Operators deciding on `MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` are misled. minimax_minimax-m3 noted this as pre-existing drift and did not report it.
- README.md:191 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` row still says "takes the head of the newest successful push or scheduled run as the base", which no longer matches the finish-order / `base_red` rule.
  WHY: Rated NIT. Documentation drift only.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:5055-5056 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `tests-main-delta` job comment still says "takes the head of the newest successful push or scheduled run as the base".
  WHY: Rated NIT. The stale wording implies a green-base fallback that no longer exists.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:5546-5551 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The reason token `ci_not_default_branch_push` is now emitted for both push and schedule events (`run.get("event") in CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH_RUN_EVENTS`), so its name is misleading.
  WHY: Rated NIT; confidence was 3 (gemini) and 4 (minimax). Consumers that grep the token will classify scheduled-run rejections as push-event rejections. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected a rename because it would break naming immutability.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:ci_main_delta_select verdict jq (also scripts/check_failure_triage.sh ci.yml base gate jq; scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh review_final_ci_sweep_base_ci_red) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "last-finished run wins" rule still lets a green delta push P (created 22:35, finished 22:45) clear a red scheduled run S (created 22:30, failed 22:40). The next push Q then takes P's sha as the base and runs only the delta, so S's failure is never tested again. The triage gate reads "success" (`pr_specific_failure`) and the sweep returns "not red".
  WHY: This breaks the script's invariant "base_red (the newest run failed: a red base stays red until a full run passes)" and Goal 6, for up to 6 hours. Suggested fix (about 5 jq lines per reader): take the newest-finished red run R and report green only if a green run was created at or after R's `updated_at`.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:ci_main_delta_output `echo "CI_MAIN_DELTA mode=output outcome=fail reason=output_write_failed ..."` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `mode=output` value is not listed in the header "Log" block or the agents.d/10156-main-push-delta-ci.md registry (`mode=select|run_tests`), and neither names `output_write_failed`.
  WHY: A log parser or heal rule built on the registered mode set will not match this line; job behaviour is unaffected.
- README.md:`MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` row (also docs/INVENTORY.md `scripts/ci_main_delta.sh` entry, ci.yml `tests-main-delta` job comment) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: These still say "takes the head of the newest successful push or scheduled run as the base", but a red last run now writes `full_required=true` (`base_red`) and there is no fallback to an older green run.
  WHY: Documentation drift that misleads operators deciding whether to flip `MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED`.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Goals 1–7, D1–D5 and the Tests list were all implemented. The Goal 6 shortfall is reported as a defect above.
- Notes: The reviewer did not adopt the `ci_not_default_branch_push` rename because it would be a contract break. The sharded-list additions were verified as sound and fail-safe. The sweep listing file has `updated_at` (review_final_ci_sweep.sh line 502).
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_main_delta.sh `until runs="$(gh api ...)"` retry loop in ci_main_delta_select. Permanent failures (401/403/404) are retried like transient ones and logged only as `reason=read_failed`. Fix: on the final attempt, classify stderr (auth / not_found / other) and append `read_category=<token>`, never echoing raw stderr. About 5 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:171 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The sort picks the newest completed run across push and scheduled events, which can be a successful delta push even though a scheduled full run failed more recently but was created earlier.
  WHY: The branch base is reported green, the failure is masked, and an invalid merge can proceed.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:578 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The triage gate sorts push and scheduled runs together and selects the newest completed run as the base.
  WHY: A green delta push completing after a red scheduled run makes the branch look healthy, so a triaged issue can resolve early.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1809 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The triage base gate sorts completed push and scheduled runs together and takes the newest one.
  WHY: A red scheduled full run is masked by a newer green delta push, so triage does not see the base as failed.
- agents.d/10156-main-push-delta-ci.md:lines 8-9 (and implicitly the script header around lines 68-69) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documented log tokens do not include `mode=output outcome=fail reason=output_write_failed`.
  WHY: Log parsers and heal rules that rely on the documented tokens will misread this failure.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:151 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The entry says the base is the head of the newest successful push or scheduled run and leaves out the full-suite fallback when the newest run is red.
  WHY: It suggests an older green run might be picked, which misleads operators.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:5546 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The reason code `ci_not_default_branch_push` is misleading because it is now also emitted for rejected scheduled runs.
  WHY: Consumers will classify scheduled-run rejections as push rejections, which confuses telemetry.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:line 5551 (`reason = "ci_not_default_branch_push"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The condition at lines 5546-5550 was widened from `run.get("event") == "push"` to `run.get("event") in CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH_RUN_EVENTS` (`("push", "schedule")`), but the reason name still says "push".
  WHY: Scheduled runs rejected with `current_run_rejected:ci_not_default_branch_push` (pinned by `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:7160`) will be classified as push-event issues. This is contract drift on a stable reason token.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE
- Notes: The reviewer did not raise three items. (1) The `scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:201-204` finish-order sort is the intended fix; the inverse case is unchanged and bounded by the 20-minute delta timeout against the ~30-minute scheduled run. (2) The `scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:106` `mode=output` line missing from the registry and header is documentation drift and out of scope. (3) The `docs/INVENTORY.md:151`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:5055` and `README.md:191` wording is pre-existing drift.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
